tools.name: search_servers
tools.description: Search public Discord servers indexed by disdex. Matches words against the server name, vanity URL, description, profile traits and guild tag. With a query, results are ranked by relevance (servers named for the query first, then matches in traits and descriptions, with bigger and more active server

tools.name: get_server
tools.description: Full details for one Discord server: description, member/online/boost counts, language, guild tag, Discord features, invite link, and how its member count changed over the last 30 days.

tools.name: get_server_activity
tools.description: Daily member and online counts for one Discord server over a time window, for questions like "is this server growing?" or "how big was it in March?". Values are daily averages of disdex's scans.

tools.name: check_invite
tools.description: Look up a Discord invite link or code (discord.gg/abc, discord.com/invite/abc, or just abc). tools.name: get_stats
tools.description: How many Discord servers, users, bots, games and invites disdex has indexed, and when those totals were last refreshed.
